items.name: One-Sentence Project
items.description: Turn a one-sentence brief into a deployable public tracker: requirements, data contract, POC gate, MVP, GitHub Pages release and evidence-based acceptance, with an executable scaffold and checker.
items.descriptionZh: 把一句话需求变成可上线的公域追踪站：需求、数据合约、POC 门禁、MVP、GitHub Pages 发布与证据化验收，附可执行脚手架与校验器。
items.author: chengxi-Z
items.whenToUse: You have a one-sentence brief to track public information over time and want a runnable, publishable and verifiable project, not just a design document.
items.whenToUseZh: 你有一句话需求，要持续追踪某领域公开信息，并希望得到可运行、可上线、可验收的项目产物，而不只是一份设计文档。
items.whenNotToUse: Generic web apps, backends, accounts, databases, real-time or high-frequency feeds, paywalled or private sources.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 通用 Web 应用、后端、账号、数据库、实时高频系统，以及付费墙或私有数据源。
usageSteps: Clone this repository (or use your local copy) and copy skills/one-sentence-project into your agent skills directory.
Describe the domain, tracking target, display form and publish target in one sentence.
Run the scaffold, then follow the SKILL.md POC -> MVP -> Release gates and keep the evidence.
usageStepsZh: 克隆本仓库（或使用已有副本），把 skills/one-sentence-project 复制到本机 Agent skills 目录。
对话中给出领域、追踪对象、展示形态与发布目标（一句话即可）。
运行脚手架，按 SKILL.md 的 POC → MVP → Release 门禁执行并留存证据。

items.name: Anthropic Agent Skills
items.description: Anthropic's public Agent Skills repository: document, design, MCP and skill-authoring skills maintained by the Anthropic team.
items.descriptionZh: Anthropic 官方公开 Agent Skills 仓库：由 Anthropic 团队维护的文档、设计、MCP 与技能编写等技能。
items.author: Anthropic
items.whenToUse: You want production-ready document, design, MCP or API skills maintained by Anthropic, or a reference for how a well-structured SKILL.md looks.
items.whenToUseZh: 你需要 Anthropic 维护的文档、设计、MCP 或 API 技能，或想参考结构规范的 SKILL.md 写法。
items.whenNotToUse: You need third-party or framework-specific skills, or a clearly licensed bundle to redistribute: the repository declares no license, so check upstream terms first.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你需要第三方或特定框架技能，或需要可明确再分发的许可：该仓库未声明许可证，使用前请先确认上游条款。
usageSteps: Clone the repository into your agent skills directory.
Pick the skill you need from skills/ and copy that folder to ~/.dsh/skills/<skill-name>/.
Reload your agent and describe the task; the skill is selected from its description.
usageStepsZh: 把仓库克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
从 skills/ 中选择需要的技能，把该文件夹复制到 ~/.dsh/skills/<技能名>/。
重新加载 Agent，描述任务，技能会按其 description 自动触发。

items.name: OpenAI Skills Catalog
items.description: OpenAI's curated Codex skills for app building, Figma, Notion, deployment and common developer workflows.
items.descriptionZh: OpenAI 官方整理的 Codex 技能目录，覆盖应用构建、Figma、Notion、部署与常见开发工作流。
items.author: OpenAI
items.whenToUse: You use Codex or another coding agent and want official, task-shaped skills for common developer workflows.
items.whenToUseZh: 你使用 Codex 或其它编码 Agent，需要面向常见开发工作流的官方任务型技能。
items.whenNotToUse: You need vendor-neutral skills or a clearly licensed bundle: the catalog targets Codex workflows and declares no repository license.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你需要厂商中立的技能或可明确再分发的许可：该目录面向 Codex 工作流且未声明仓库许可证。
usageSteps: Clone the catalog into your agent skills directory.
Choose a skill under skills/.curated/ and copy it to ~/.dsh/skills/<skill-name>/.
Reload the agent and ask for the matching task.
usageStepsZh: 把技能目录克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
在 skills/.curated/ 下选择技能，复制到 ~/.dsh/skills/<技能名>/。
重新加载 Agent 并请求对应任务。

items.name: Vercel Agent Skills
items.description: Vercel's official agent skills for React and Next.js best practices, deployment, web design and CLI workflows.
items.descriptionZh: Vercel 官方 Agent Skills：React/Next.js 最佳实践、部署、Web 设计与 CLI 工作流。
items.author: Vercel Labs
items.whenToUse: You build or deploy React / Next.js apps on Vercel and want official guidance packaged as agent skills.
items.whenToUseZh: 你在 Vercel 上构建或部署 React / Next.js 应用，希望以 Agent Skills 形式使用官方指导。
items.whenNotToUse: Your stack is not React or Vercel: the collection is stack-specific and declares no repository license.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你的技术栈不是 React 或 Vercel：该合集与栈强相关，且未声明仓库许可证。
usageSteps: Clone the repository into your agent skills directory.
Copy the skills you need from skills/ into ~/.dsh/skills/<skill-name>/.
Reload the agent and start the React or deployment task.
usageStepsZh: 把仓库克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
把 skills/ 中需要的技能复制到 ~/.dsh/skills/<技能名>/。
重新加载 Agent 后开始 React 或部署任务。

items.name: GitHub Awesome Copilot
items.nameZh: GitHub Awesome Copilot 技能合集
items.description: GitHub's MIT-licensed collection of hundreds of skills, instructions and agents for GitHub Copilot and compatible coding agents.
items.descriptionZh: GitHub 官方 MIT 许可合集：面向 GitHub Copilot 及兼容编码 Agent 的数百个技能、指令与 Agent。
items.author: GitHub
items.whenToUse: You use GitHub Copilot or a compatible agent and want a broad, MIT-licensed library of community-contributed skills to copy from.
items.whenToUseZh: 你使用 GitHub Copilot 或兼容 Agent，想要一个 MIT 许可、范围广、可直接取用的社区贡献技能库。
items.whenNotToUse: You need one polished skill rather than a large collection; quality and ownership vary per entry.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你需要单个精修技能而非大型合集：合集中各条目的质量与归属不一。
usageSteps: Clone the collection into your agent skills directory.
Pick a skill from skills/ (or .github/skills/) and copy its folder into your skills directory.
Reload the agent and describe the task.
usageStepsZh: 把合集克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
从 skills/（或 .github/skills/）挑选技能，把文件夹复制到你的 skills 目录。
重新加载 Agent 并描述任务。

items.name: Microsoft Skills
items.description: Microsoft's MIT-licensed skills for Azure, Microsoft Foundry, MCP servers and SDKs, packaged for coding agents.
items.descriptionZh: Microsoft 官方 MIT 许可技能库：Azure、Microsoft Foundry、MCP Server 与 SDK，按编码 Agent 形态打包。
items.author: Microsoft
items.whenToUse: You work with Azure, Microsoft Foundry, MCP servers or Microsoft SDKs and want official agent guidance and templates.
items.whenToUseZh: 你使用 Azure、Microsoft Foundry、MCP Server 或 Microsoft SDK，希望获得官方 Agent 指导与模板。
items.whenNotToUse: You are not on the Microsoft / Azure stack: the skills assume specific SDKs, services and plugin layouts.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你不在 Microsoft / Azure 技术栈上：这些技能依赖特定 SDK、服务与插件结构。
usageSteps: Clone the repository into your agent skills directory.
Pick a plugin/skill under .github/plugins/ and copy the skill folder into your agent skills directory.
Reload the agent and start the Azure or SDK task.
usageStepsZh: 把仓库克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
在 .github/plugins/ 下选择插件/技能，把对应技能文件夹复制到 Agent skills 目录。
重新加载 Agent 后开始 Azure 或 SDK 任务。

items.name: Superpowers
items.description: A widely used MIT-licensed skills framework that packages a full software development methodology for coding agents: brainstorm, plan, TDD, review, verify.
items.descriptionZh: 广受欢迎的 MIT 许可技能框架，把完整软件开发方法论（头脑风暴、计划、TDD、评审、验证）打包给编码 Agent。
items.author: obra
items.whenToUse: You want a complete, opinionated development workflow available to your coding agent rather than isolated helper prompts.
items.whenToUseZh: 你希望编码 Agent 拥有一套完整、有主见的开发工作流，而不是零散的辅助提示词。
items.whenNotToUse: You need a single narrow helper skill, or your agent does not support the plugin / skill-directory format.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你只需要单个窄用途技能，或你的 Agent 不支持插件 / 技能目录形式。
usageSteps: Clone the framework into your agent skills directory.
Follow its README to install the plugin or copy skills/* into your agent skills directory.
Start a coding task and let the workflow skills guide planning, TDD and review.
usageStepsZh: 把框架克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
按 README 安装插件，或把 skills/* 复制到 Agent skills 目录。
开始编码任务，由工作流技能引导计划、TDD 与评审。

items.name: Marketing Skills
items.description: MIT-licensed marketing skills for Claude Code and other agents: CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, ads and growth engineering.
items.descriptionZh: 面向 Claude Code 等 Agent 的 MIT 许可营销技能包：CRO、文案、SEO、分析、广告与增长工程。
items.author: Corey Haines
items.whenToUse: Your agent needs marketing workflows: landing-page CRO, copywriting, SEO, ads, email or analytics tasks.
items.whenToUseZh: 你的 Agent 需要营销工作流：落地页 CRO、文案、SEO、广告、邮件或分析任务。
items.whenNotToUse: You need engineering, data-analysis or research skills: the scope is intentionally marketing-specific.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你需要工程、数据分析或研究类技能：该包刻意聚焦营销场景。
usageSteps: Clone the collection into your agent skills directory.
Copy the skills you need from skills/ into ~/.dsh/skills/<skill-name>/.
Reload the agent and ask for the marketing task.
usageStepsZh: 把合集克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
把 skills/ 中需要的技能复制到 ~/.dsh/skills/<技能名>/。
重新加载 Agent 并请求对应营销任务。

items.name: Awesome Agent Skills (VoltAgent)
items.description: A curated index of 1000+ agent skills from official teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and more.
items.descriptionZh: 精选索引：1000+ 来自官方团队与社区的 Agent Skills，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 等。
items.author: VoltAgent
items.whenToUse: You want to discover skills by domain and compare options across vendors, harnesses and ecosystems.
items.whenToUseZh: 你想按领域发现技能，并在不同厂商、Agent 与生态之间横向比较。
items.whenNotToUse: You need a ready-to-run skill inside this repository: it is a curated index, and each skill lives in its own upstream repo.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你希望本仓库内就有可运行技能：它是精选索引，具体技能位于各自上游仓库。
usageSteps: Clone the index and browse its README by category.
Open the upstream repository of the skill you want.
Install that skill into your agent skills directory and reload the agent.
usageStepsZh: 克隆索引仓库，按分类浏览 README。
打开目标技能对应的上游仓库。
把该技能安装到 Agent skills 目录并重新加载 Agent。

items.name: Awesome Agent Skills (heilcheng)
items.description: MIT-licensed tutorials, guides and directories for Agent Skills across Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and MCP.
items.descriptionZh: MIT 许可的 Agent Skills 教程、指南与目录，覆盖 Claude、Codex、Copilot、Cursor 与 MCP。
items.author: heilcheng
items.whenToUse: You are new to Agent Skills and want tutorials, guides and a directory to understand the format before installing anything.
items.whenToUseZh: 你刚接触 Agent Skills，想先通过教程、指南与目录理解格式，再安装具体技能。
items.whenNotToUse: You want a skill folder you can drop in and run immediately: this repository is learning material and a directory.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你希望直接放入即可运行的技能目录：本仓库是学习资料与索引。
usageSteps: Clone or browse the repository.
Read the tutorial that matches your agent and use the directory to find a skill.
Install the chosen upstream skill into your agent skills directory.
usageStepsZh: 克隆或浏览该仓库。
阅读与你的 Agent 匹配的教程，并用目录查找技能。
把选中的上游技能安装到 Agent skills 目录。

items.name: Agentic Plugin Marketplace
items.description: A multi-harness MIT-licensed marketplace of 180+ agent skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode.
items.descriptionZh: MIT 许可的多平台 Agent 插件市场：180+ 技能与插件，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 与 OpenCode。
items.author: wshobson
items.whenToUse: You want a plugin marketplace of skills and subagents that works across several coding-agent harnesses.
items.whenToUseZh: 你想要一个跨多个编码 Agent 平台可用的技能与子 Agent 插件市场。
items.whenNotToUse: You want a single self-contained skill with no plugin or marketplace layer.
items.whenNotToUseZh: 你想要单个自包含技能，不想要插件 / 市场层。
usageSteps: Clone the marketplace into your agent skills directory.
Follow its README to add the marketplace or copy a plugin's skills into your agent skills directory.
Reload the agent and start the task.
usageStepsZh: 把市场克隆到本机 Agent skills 目录。
按 README 添加市场，或把某个插件下的技能复制到 Agent skills 目录。
重新加载 Agent 后开始任务。
